summary: Bounded archaeology found source code and multiple read-only STT probe workflows, but no canonical repository deployment owner/mechanism for study-transcribe-v1. The absence is recorded as scoped SOURCE_DEBT rather than claiming that no external deployment procedure has ever existed. One successor was materialized to establish a durable owner/contract without deploying Supabase.

tests.name: canonical_source_present
tests.evidence: study-transcribe-v1 source and selftest contract are present with pinned SHAs.

tests.name: stt_workflow_classification
tests.evidence: Exact selftest, paired-liveness and egress workflows are read-only probes and contain no deployment step.

tests.name: supabase_repo_config
tests.evidence: supabase/config.toml is absent and the supabase root contains only functions/migrations/rollbacks/tests.

tests.name: study_pipeline_separation
tests.evidence: Study content pipeline verifies content/contracts and does not deploy the edge function.

tests.name: successor_materialized
tests.evidence: A single no-deploy owner-establishment successor was created after exact-path dedupe returned 404.

unresolved: A canonical deployment owner/contract must be established before any future deploy can be treated as grounded Prometeo work.
